item.title: La Jolla museum to showcase art from Alicia Keys, Swizz Beatz's private collection
item.description: A San Diego museum will host the West Coast debut of a large-scale exhibit featuring artwork collected by the musical husband-and-wife team, Alicia Keys and Swizz Beatz.

item.title: 'Grey's Anatomy' star Eric Dane dies after ALS battle
item.description: Actor Eric Dane, best known for his role as Dr. Mark Sloan ("McSteamy") on ABC's "Grey's Anatomy" has died at the age of 53.

item.title: Rep. Juan Vargas joins downtown rally to protest ICE
item.description: Rep. Juan Vargas attended a rally hosted by immigration advocates and labor leaders to support the immigrant community and protest ICE raids and arrests.

item.title: Three-day rainfall totals across San Diego County
item.description: San Diego County experienced widespread rain, gusty winds, and some snow due to two winter storms this week, with precipitation totals varying from 0.32 to 5.92 inches depending on the area.

item.title: Former nonprofit COO accused of using grant money for cosmetic surgery
item.description: Prosecutors have charged the former chief operating officer of a San Diego nonprofit with embezzling public grant money intended to prevent fentanyl overdoses.

item.title: San Diego airport records busiest year ever
item.description: San Diego International Airport experienced its busiest year in history in 2025, with 25.3 million passengers traveling in and out of the airport.

item.title: San Diego stabbing suspect's arraignment delayed for mental evaluation
item.description: The arraignment for the suspect accused of stabbing and killing a man in downtown San Diego was postponed due to mental competency issues.

item.title: San Diego to pay insurers $6.3 million while flood victims still seek damages
item.description: SAN DIEGO, Calif. (FOX 5/KUSI) — The City of San Diego will pay $6.3 million to insurance companies that covered losses from devastating floods two years ago. item.title: La Jolla's iconic 'Mushroom House' undergoing renovations
item.description: A La Jolla-based contractor has begun renovations on the "Mushroom House," a 58-year-old architectural landmark buried into the cliffs above San Diego's Blacks Beach.

item.title: Deputy-involved shooting in San Marcos leaves one person dead
item.description: A 33-year-old man was shot and killed by deputies in San Marcos after he allegedly armed himself with a handgun during a traffic stop.
